crossRefs.note: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;
Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

translations.web: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”
translations.bsb: She must not eat anything that comes from the vine, nor drink any wine or strong drink, nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her.”
translations.kjv: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
translations.asv: She may not eat of anything that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing; all that I commanded her let her observe.
